answer: A sybil farm must fund fresh identities and sustain honest attestations across many epochs, so fake accounts drift like footprints on a shifting dune, erased before they reach the verification horizon. Agents stake a bonded deposit that decays along a downward spiral with each attestation missed, and reputation is earned only by peer-verified work recorded on-chain. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities while honest agents accumulate durable trust, making mass duplication economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0251's threat model.
